NETWORK.NAME: ContinueOrAdjust_F6_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest

gate=encounter.kind == followup AND BaselineCurrency == linked_current; registration yields not_applicable; outdated, unreconciled, unknown, missing, or conflicting baseline linkage yields needs_clarification

cdss_resolution=STATEMENT-06 (2B) is not appropriate for electronic decision support or quality measurement per its Quality Measurement Considerations, and BN-06 carries a guideline_restriction property to that effect. This network produces physician review prompts only, never an automated continue-or-switch recommendation, never a quality-measure output, and never a dose, taper, or product choice. Owner approval of this scope is required before activation; copying BN-06 tables or flags is not the resolution.

causal_note=Observed treatment and course variables are conditioning context for review-prompt estimation only. Conditioning on an observed strategy or course never identifies an intervention effect. All BN-05/06 outcome nodes (relapse, hospitalization, sustained exposure, regimen discontinuation, destabilization, metabolic trajectory) and observed strategy nodes are excluded by design; no posterior is a treatment-effect estimate.

scope_note=One network, one prompt, one question step. No runtime merge of BN-04/05/06 occurs; their deterministic workflow tables were replaced with soft argmax-preserving placeholders, and no BN TABLE bytes or inference or deployment flags were copied. LAI product choice belongs to its own question scope; this network records LAI mismatch only as template context.

VARIABLE.NAME: ImprovementStatus
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Current improvement course (clinician judgment)

definition=Whether the clinician records the course as improved and stable on the current treatment, or as carrying residual clinical burden (significant residual symptoms or functional difficulties despite some response). Recorded with symptom domains, validated scale name and version, and baseline reference. Never inferred from a PANSS total, band, or percent change. Required input; missing blocks. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-05 Implementation (prior improvement; residual burden) + STATEMENT-06 Implementation (response with residual symptoms); field proposed, not collected
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: CourseContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Longitudinal course context (clinician judgment)

definition=Whether the clinician documents chronic symptoms or repeated prior relapses (proposed composite requiring operational criteria), or records a non-chronic course. Optional context in v0.1: estimated as a root and rendered as a discussion item; it conditions no child output. Unknown is not a negative finding. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=BN-05 ChronicOrRepeatedRelapseCourse lead; field proposed, not collected
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: TolerabilityContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Current tolerability burden (aggregate of assessed effects)

definition=Aggregate of the four FR-21 follow-up effect assessments (tardive dyskinesia, akathisia, parkinsonism, acute dystonia with severities), the recorded significant-side-effects assessment, and the recorded metabolic concern (weight gain, diabetes, or metabolic syndrome without numeric thresholds). none_assessed requires every constituent assessed negative. Required input; any missing or not_assessed constituent, or any present-without-severity effect, blocks. Proposed aggregation of collected effects plus two proposed fields.
source=history-effects-v0.1-draft (awaiting_review) + STATEMENT-06 Implementation (metabolic and other tolerability reasons); aggregation proposed for review
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: PreferenceBarrier
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Patient preference barrier to ongoing medication

definition=Whether the patient expresses reluctance or barriers to ongoing medication in shared decision-making, including same-agent continuation preference detail recorded in the field. Optional in v0.1: unknown maps to unknown_incomplete with disclosure and permits inference. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-05/06 Patient Preferences + BN-05/BN-06 preference leads; field proposed, not collected
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AdherenceContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Adherence difficulty (clinician assessment)

definition=Whether the clinician assesses difficulty maintaining prescribed treatment during the exposure interval; dispensing records alone do not establish ingestion. Optional in v0.1 with unknown disclosure. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-05 Implementation (adherence barriers) + BN-05 AdherenceDifficulty lead; field proposed, not collected
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ExposureChangeContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Pharmacokinetic or exposure change context

definition=Whether the clinician identifies a relevant change in interacting medicines, smoking, body mass, renal or hepatic status, or absorption; direction is not inferred. Optional in v0.1 with unknown disclosure. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-05 Implementation (pharmacokinetic factors) + BN-05 PharmacokineticChange lead; field proposed, not collected
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: PracticalAvailability
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Practical availability of the current agent

definition=Whether the same active antipsychotic remains accessible, including access and formulary barriers. LAI formulation mismatch is recorded in the field and rendered as template context only; LAI choice is governed by its own question scope, not this network. Optional in v0.1 with unknown disclosure. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-06 Implementation (availability; LAI formulation) + BN-06 CurrentAgentAvailable lead; field proposed, not collected
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Urgent safety concern (current)

definition=Clinician-identified urgent safety concern requiring a separate assessment pathway, including suspected NMS, cardiac toxicity, severe constipation, infection or neutropenia, seizure, or acute psychiatric danger. Absent means none identified, not that risk is zero. Required input; missing blocks and the deterministic flag never waits for inference. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-04/05/06 safety paragraphs + BN-04/05/06 urgent leads; field proposed, not collected
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ContinuationDiscussion
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Continuation discussion review output

definition=Posterior over review prompts: continuation discussion vs individualized change review. OutsideScope is estimated for contract completeness and never occurs when the gate holds (gate-false yields not_applicable without inference). Not a recommendation, not a dose or taper order, not a prediction of relapse or hospitalization.
source=proposed for review; suggestion strengths applied only as review wording, never as probabilities
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AdherenceSupportReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Adherence support review output
definition=Posterior over whether to prompt a barriers, supports, and acceptable formulations review. Triggered does not select an LAI. Routine monitoring continues even when not triggered.
source=proposed for review; BN-05 AdherenceSupportReview lead restructured
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: TolerabilityExposureReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Tolerability or exposure review output
definition=Posterior over whether to prompt a focused side-effect or exposure review. Routine monitoring continues even when not triggered.
source=proposed for review; BN-05 TolerabilityOrExposureReview lead restructured
status=proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Urgent safety review output
definition=Urgent concerns take priority regardless of discussion status; rendered from saved inputs alongside posteriors via the deterministic flag.
source=STATEMENT-04/05/06 safety paragraphs; proposed for review
status=proposed_for_review
